verdict.rationale: Bento documents one public HTTP interface: an OTLP ingest endpoint with an auth header that accepts traces even without a Bento package. Full product control (issues, runs, signals, analytics) is documented only through the CLI, which belongs to a separate story and is not credited here, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. missing for 10: a documented REST/GraphQL management and query API, an OpenAPI spec, API reference docs for reading runs, issues and signals, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: point its exporter at one endpoint with one auth header and the traces land in Bento. In TypeScript you can do this with no Bento package at all.
JavaScript's OpenTelemetry exporters can emit JSON, so you can send traces to Bento without installing any Bento package.
